fields.headline: Adds $227,030 to Ninyo & Moore's contract for added environmental cleanup work at Fremont High
fields.summary: The district is expanding an existing environmental services contract with Ninyo & Moore for the Fremont High School new construction project. The added work revises a cleanup plan and prepares completion and monitoring reports requested by the California Department of Toxic Substances Control. The change adds $206,391.00 for basic services plus $20,639.10 for additional services, $227,030.10 in all, raising the contract limit from $175,645.80 to $402,675.90.

22-2666.note: The amount added by this action was corrected from $206,391 (basic services only) to $227,030.10 (basic plus additional services).

fields.headline: County raises its payment cap for district special education counseling services by $39,190 to $1,245,047
fields.summary: This first amendment raises the contract maximum under the district's 2021-22 agreement with Alameda County Behavioral Health from $1,205,857 to $1,245,047, an increase of $39,190. The district is the County's contractor: it provides Counseling Enriched Special Day Class services (special education classes with added counseling) and the County pays it, funded by Medi-Cal billing revenue. The amendment also replaces the budget, rate sheet and another exhibit. It covers July 1, 2021 to June 30, 2022, a period that ended before this vote.

22-2686.sourceIssue: The text names the District as "Contractor" but says the County provides the services, so it is unclear whether the added $39,190 is paid by or to the District; the attached agreement shows the District provides the services and is paid by the County.
